heading: Cover letter
body:
I am a Cape Town backend and software engineer targeting global remote Senior and Lead roles. I am Tech Lead on SAWIS BI: I own the PHP application and the MySQL import/export path, and I recover failed jobs. I do not own that client's servers. I own Indawo as the client engineer — spec, cost, plan, ship — and I coordinate a project manager, a senior developer, and a mid developer who do not report to me on paper. Overdrive's contract title is Software Developer; the work is technical leadership on the systems I own.

When Indawo's on-prem host died I containerised the legacy PHP app with Docker, fixed networking, and restored production. It now runs on an Azure VM I operate at the guest-OS layer, not the cloud account. On AWS I use existing EC2, RDS, Lambda, and IAM. I hold AWS DevOps Engineer Professional. I am not a platform team and I am not a Staff Engineer today.

I am building toward Staff in the open: design notes on the systems I already run, stronger observability than 'debug when it breaks,' and Kubernetes in a homelab until I have it in industry. I like hard problems and I am easy to work with. I work SAST (UTC+2) from South Africa, flexible hours while I finish a BSc in Information Technology at Eduvos beside a full working week.

Thank you for your time. I would welcome a conversation.
